intern_ian.name: Intern Ian
intern_ian.intro: Hey! You look like you know how to restart things. Battle me!
intern_ian.defeat: I should have opened a ticket first...
intern_ian.after: I'm still on probation. Please don't tell my manager.

sysadmin_sam.name: Sysadmin Sam
sysadmin_sam.intro: Nobody walks through my cable run without a change request!
sysadmin_sam.after: Label your cables. I'm begging you.

jogger_jo.name: Jogger Jo
jogger_jo.intro: I run every morning. My Ramster runs every millisecond!
jogger_jo.defeat: Out of breath. And out of RAM.
jogger_jo.after: Stretch before you battle. Trust me.
